title: pleurospermopsis sikkimensis
intro: Pleurospermopsis sikkimensis, commonly known as Sikkim pleurospermopsis, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is a shrub-like herb native to the Himalayan region. The plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pleurospermopsis sikkimensis include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as pain relief, wound healing, and immune system support.
